candidates.original_title: Accentuate the positive: Semantic access in English compounds
candidates.description: The influence of six semantic variables (valence, arousal, imageability, concreteness, sensory experience ratings, and body-object interaction ratings) on lexical decision times for English compound words
candidates.notes: The paper follows the approach of Kuperman (2013) and tests the same variables using eye movements instead of LDTs, which constitutes a conceptual replication. However, the paper does not explicitly frame itself as a replication, and the results are mixed (some variables replicate, some do not). [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: A database of 629 English compound words: Ratings of familiarity, lexeme meaning dominance, semantic transparency, age-of-acquisition, imageability, and sensory experience
candidates.description: The influence of six semantic variables (familiarity, age-of-acquisition, sensory experience ratings, imageability, semantic transparency, and lexeme meaning dominance) on lexical decision times and word naming times for English compound words
candidates.notes: The paper follows the approach of Juhasz et al. (2015) and tests the same variables using eye movements instead of LDTs, which constitutes a conceptual replication. However, the paper does not explicitly frame itself as a replication, and the results are mixed (some variables replicate, some do not). [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]
